subject: Request: Multi-year Rate Safeguard & Renewal Grace Term (DealDesk Escalation)
body:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Multi-year Rate Safeguard & Renewal Grace Term (DealDesk Escalation)

Team — need an exec ok on a one-off concession for NimbleHealth.

Summary: NimbleHealth is asking for a 3-year committed term with two non-standard commercial asks: (1) a price-lock for the initial 36 months with an annual uplift cap (they propose 5%), and (2) a renewal protection clause that limits first renewal increase to the uplift cap unless material usage growth > 50%. They also want a short early-exit right tied to acquisition.

Why: This is a mid-market healthcare analytics customer (Procure SPOC: procure@nimblehealth.com). They sign quickly if we can give renewal predictability and a moderate uplift cap. Current forecast: $1.6M ARR year-one, sizable expansion upside. Sales wants a clean closed-won by end of month.

Ask: Executive approval for a 3-year term with up to 7% annual uplift cap (counter to their 5%), include a one-time renewal protection for first renewal only, and allow a narrowly scoped early-exit for change-of-control with 60-day notice and pro-rated usage settlement. Approval conditional on Legal (Ben) sign-off on clause language and Deal Desk stamping the concession in HubSpot. Attachments: summary + SOW draft.

Notes: if we say no, they may walk to a competitor offering a 3-year price lock. If we say yes without guardrails, we open a precedent for other health vertical deals.

Thanks,
Vivek
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Multi-year Rate Safeguard & Renewal Grace Term (DealDesk Escalation)

Vivek — good summary. A couple quick clarifying points before execs sign:
- Is there a minimum committed spend per year or just seat-based? (we should require minimums)
- Do we need to offer any SLA credits tied to the renewal protection?
- How material is the legal ask on early-exit; can we limit it to specific change-of-control thresholds?

If Ben is comfortable with guardrails and we land uplift at 7% max I am inclined to approve. Please attach the numbers (yr1/yr2/yr3 ARR and expected consumption) and mark the concession in HubSpot.

—Marissa
Head of Sales

----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: NimbleHealth counter / requested language

Forwarded message:
From: Clara Zhou <clara.zhou@nimblehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@nimblehealth.com>, Gregory Mills <greg.mills@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Term sheet comments

Vivek — thanks for the proposal. Nimble is prepared to commit to 3 years if Redwood will: (a) lock pricing for the first 36 months with max+floor uplift mechanics, (b) limit first renewal increase to no greater than the uplift cap unless usage growth >50%, and (c) include a standard change-of-control exit with 90-day notice and 30% termination fee. We prefer no minimum spend, but we can commit to a volume forecast to base consumption estimates. Attached are the redlined clauses from our counsel.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Clara
Director, Procurement
NimbleHealth

----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Multi-year Rate Safeguard & Renewal Grace Term (DealDesk Escalation)

Reviewed the redlines and propose the following legal guardrails:
- Approve a 3-year price lock window. Counter-propose uplift cap at 7% annually (cap only applies to list-rate increases; usage-based tiers can change if they exceed forecast materially).
- Renewal protection: limit to first renewal only; add a materiality threshold (usage >50% year-over-year) to allow larger uplift.
- Change-of-control exit: reduce to 60-day notice and prohibit a termination fee above 15% of remaining committed value.
- Require minimum annual committed spend of 60% of forecasted year spend to avoid churn risk.
- All concessions to be documented in HubSpot, and Commercial Operations will add a one-time concession code for precedence tracking.

If Sales accepts Ben's counters, Legal will prepare redlined language for signature. Recommend exec sign-off.

—Ben
VP, Legal & Contracts

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Multi-year Rate Safeguard & Renewal Grace Term (DealDesk Escalation)

Approved.

Decision summary for documentation:
- Approve 3-year term with a 7% annual uplift cap (applies to list-rate changes).
- Renewal protection limited to the first renewal only; materiality clause (usage >50% yoy) allows larger uplift.
- Change-of-control early-exit permitted with 60-day notice; termination fee capped at 15% of remaining committed value.
- Require minimum annual committed spend = 60% of forecast per year.
- Legal (Ben) to produce redline; Commercial Ops to add concession code and update HubSpot (link above).

Vivek — proceed to present Ben's counters to Nimble, attach the SOW and term summary, and request an updated redline from their counsel. Once we have that, Legal will finalize for signature and we will route to exec for final DocuSign.

—Marissa
Head of Sales
Redwood Inference
